findings.highlight: She's never told us anything she wants to do for herself.
findings.evidenceJa: あいつが自分から何かやるって今までなかっただろ。
findings.governingReading: 自分から何かやる is independent initiative;7 discusses the exception of voluntarily protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Saber not initiating action becomes not telling them personal wishes.

findings.highlight: I just don't know why she's so selfless.
findings.evidenceJa: あんまりにも無欲すぎるのが分からない。
findings.governingReading: 無欲 asks why she seems without wants; Rin replies that she still has an objective, then separately distinguishes her goal from personal benefit.
findings.explanation: Absence of desires becomes moral selflessness.

findings.highlight: it must have some hope of saving her.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女自身を救う『望み』でないワケがない。
findings.governingReading: The double negation categorically concludes what kind of wish she must have, fueling his mistaken excitement before Rin corrects him.
findings.explanation: The wish necessarily being her own salvation becomes merely having some hope of saving her.

findings.governingReading: He begins on what grounds but cannot finish saying the challenge; the next source narration supplies the unsaid completion.
findings.explanation: The aborted question becomes a completed question before narration says it cannot be asked.

findings.highlight: I pushed my distorted desire on her.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の姿を、ねじ曲げた。
findings.governingReading: He briefly represents her as he wants her to be; the object of ねじ曲げた is her perceived figure, not the intrinsic moral status of wanting her rescued.
findings.explanation: Distorting the mental picture of Saber becomes imposing a desire that is itself called distorted.

findings.highlight: he made no effort to communicate with Saber or me.
findings.evidenceJa: 努めて俺やセイバーとは接触しなかった。
findings.governingReading: 努めて...接触しなかった asserts purposeful avoidance of contact, not merely no effort at social communication.
findings.explanation: Deliberately maintaining distance becomes absence of initiative to communicate.
